## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `feat/`, `fix/`, `chore/`, `docs/`, or `test/` convention
- [ ] Diff is focused, self-reviewed, and has no unrelated changes
- [ ] Backend format, lint, strict typecheck, and tests pass
- [ ] Frontend format, lint, strict typecheck, tests, and build pass
- [ ] Compose configuration and relevant profile smoke test pass
- [ ] Security/SAST/dependency/secret/image checks pass or have an approved ADR
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and negative authorization/privacy cases where relevant
- [ ] Documentation, `.env.example`, OpenAPI, and compliance map are current
- [ ] No document content, raw prompt, PHI, credential, or external AI call was added
